# DataLayerAudit.onError property

Told when the trail could not record a write as it should. Omitted, `console.error`<!-- -->, plus the runtime's `ctx.log.warn` when it has one. See [AuditOptions.onError](/api/pg-prisma/latest/pg-prisma.auditoptions.onerror/)<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
onError?: AuditOptions['onError'];
```
